SECTION 5 VISUAL METEOROLOGICAL CONDITIONS
SERA.5005 Visual flight rules
Regulation (EU) No 923/2012
(a) Except when operating as a special VFR flight, VFR flights shall be conducted so that:
(1) the aircraft is flown in conditions of visibility and distance from cloud equal to or greater
than those specified in Table S5-1;
(2) the aircraft is flown clear of cloud.
(b) Except when a clearance is obtained from an air traffic control unit, VFR flights shall not take off or land at an
aerodrome within a control zone:
(1) when the ceiling is less than 450 m (1 500 ft); or
(i) first roman item;
(ii) second roman item;
(2) when the ground visibility is less than 5 km.
(c) Third paragraph.
AMC1 SERA.5005(b) Visual flight rules
Text of the acceptable means of compliance for point (b).
GM1 SERA.5005 Visual flight rules
Text of the guidance material for the rule.
SERA.5010 Special VFR in control zones
(a) Special VFR flights may be authorised to operate within a control zone.
